domain: Finite rational weighted paired units, nonnegative weights summing to one; r0,r1,p0,p1 in [0,1]. Covered pairs obey both directed probability gaps <= m; uncovered mass <= epsilon. m and epsilon in [0,1].
primary_obligation: L1-L0 <= R1-(1-m)*max(0,R0+R1-1-epsilon), with mirrored negative bound.
sharpness: Construct five binary-gate strata at minimal intersection, concentrate bad mass on that intersection, use good-both p0=(1-m)/2,p1=(1+m)/2 and exclusive/extreme probabilities. Attainment in bounded-probability class; only supremal generally for finite real logits.
optional_odds_obligation: Rational k>=1, rho in [0,1], t>=0. Pointwise nonnegative Q(t)=k*(B-rho)*t^2+((k+1)*B-(k-1+rho))*t+B implies k*t/(1+k*t)-(1-rho)*t/(1+t)<=B. Stronger universally checkable quadratic certificate if feasible.
interpretation_boundary: No new empirical estimation, nuisance calibration, coupling identification, real exponential/square-root proof, or ethical conclusion. General real logistic sharpness belongs to separate analytical note.
verification: Pinned Lean4.29.1 Std only, fresh source-frozen temporary build; audit every theorem; no proof holes/custom axioms/native shortcuts; preserve failed attempts.
